BHHU-ATRA Database Fixes — Action List

Issues in the source Excel database that require manual correction

Published

June 22, 2026

Purpose

This report surfaces specific data quality issues in Database/baza_gdrive.xlsx that cannot be fixed by the pipeline and require manual correction by the ATRA data team. It complements the Data Quality Report (02_quality.qmd), which covers pipeline validation flags and DwC readiness.

Each section identifies the affected records so they can be located and corrected in the Excel file directly. All tables are searchable and paginated.

Issue summary

Missing data overview (naniar)

Both empty cells and "n/a" strings are treated as missing for this analysis.

Missingness heatmap

Each row is one record; each column is one field. Black = missing, grey = present.

Taxon name anomalies

TAKSON values that do not exactly match any entry in the 2_ID taksona reference sheet — likely spelling mistakes, outdated synonyms, or variants not yet added to the reference.

Fix: Correct the spelling in TAKSON or add the variant to 2_ID taksona as an accepted synonym.

Vocabulary issues

Month field (Mjesec nalaza) — unknown values

Values not in the month dictionary — they cannot be parsed and produce year-only eventDate records.

Fix: Replace with the correct standard Bosnian month name (Januar … Decembar).

Month field — date ranges

Records where Mjesec nalaza contains a range (e.g. Maj-Oktobar). A single month cannot be derived, so eventDate is year-only.

Fix: Leave the month blank and move the range to NAPOMENE, or record the start month only.

basisOfRecord (Vrsta reference) — unknown values

Fix: Replace with one of the accepted terms: Terenski podaci, Literaturni podaci, Podaci iz izvještaja, Podaci iz zooloških kolekcija, Kolekcija ZMS, Ostalo.

No unknown basisOfRecord values detected.

Country field (Drzava) — variant spellings

Multiple abbreviations are in use for the same country. The pipeline maps all known variants, but a single standard should be enforced in the database.

Fix: Standardise to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: BA (BiH), HR (Croatia), ME (Montenegro), RS (Serbia), AL (Albania), BG (Bulgaria), HU (Hungary), GR (Greece). Apply an Excel dropdown to enforce this going forward.

Date issues

Impossible dates

Day value is out of range for the given month (e.g. day 31 in April).

Fix: Correct the day value, or clear the day and leave year + month only.

Coordinate issues

Records outside the BiH bounding box

Coordinates are outside the expected range (lat 42–46°N, lon 15.7–19.7°E). May be legitimate records from neighbouring countries or coordinate entry errors.

Fix: Verify the coordinates and confirm Drzava matches. Correct or blank the coordinates if they are wrong.

Duplicate record IDs

Records that share an ID podatka with at least one other record.

Fix: Assign unique IDs to the duplicates. Contact the pipeline team first — ID changes affect occurrenceID stability.

No duplicate IDs detected.
